newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria's ATX ends at record high for 7th day.
newsitem.headline: Austria's ATX ends at record high for 7th day.

text.p: 1310 GMT - Austria's ATX index extended its winning streak on Tuesday, ending at a record closing high for the seventh day, albeit off earlier highs.

Traders said the underlying sentiment remained positive amid continuing strong leads from abroad, but added the ATX was likely to take a breather over the next few days before staging a renewed attack on the key 1,400 points mark.
* ATX index up 0.82 pts or 0.06 pct at 1,391.40
* 10 ATX members up, 10 down, one unchanged
* Top gainer OMV, up 3.27 pct at 1,673 ats
* July ATX futures down 5.5 pts at 1,397.5 on volume of 2,311 contracts
